name: case-a-long-run
description: Case A: about 6 minutes of game with nobody playing. The title's attract camera tours the level for 50 s (its camera wraps from the right end back to x 0 four times, so the level columns are streamed again and again), then Coin and 1P Start, and player 1 stands at the start for over 5 minutes while the Troopers walk their patrols. The game must still be running and drawing at the end.
